tasks.short: Publicize programs through newsletters, bulletins and mailings

steps.what: Confirm programme details, publication channels and permitted audience
Draft newsletters, bulletins and mailings to publicize programs

loop.purpose: Draft concise programme announcements from verified facts
loop.input: Publication brief and existing approved template
loop.check: Director verifies purpose, eligibility, date, location and tone against the brief, with no invented promises
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates place facts but adapting an explanation to a channel requires language judgement

steps.what: Edit the final announcement and approve its exact audience and channels
Place the approved announcement in the selected publication or mailing

tasks.design: Reuse publication templates in {DOCS} and native scheduling in {CMS} and {EMAIL}. A bounded assistant drafts from verified programme facts; only the director-approved content and audience can be published.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated announcement drafting and placement across channels.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates and scheduled publishing can reuse an approved publication snapshot.
tasks.still_hard: Tone, eligibility and sensitive audience information need careful checks.
tasks.human_edge: The director judges what accurately and respectfully represents the programme.
tasks.altitude: Less drafting and placement; publication authority remains human.

evidence.claim: Template-based drafting and approved native publication are plausible; proposed savings are unmeasured.
Religious membership is special-category data under GDPR article9.

assumptions: Boundary covers one programme announcement from brief to publication, excluding programme design and separate member-register maintenance.

Director captures programme purpose, title, eligibility, time, location and contact in s1's25 hours and produces exact final content, recipient selection, channel and publication time in s3's20 hours. Member administrator supplies existing contact preferences through unchanged register work; missing permission or address blocks that recipient and requires manual clarification.
Test native templates and scheduling first. No counselling content enters drafting; existing automatic publishing earns no new saving.
research_questions: Does assisted publicity reduce total time after factual and audience checks?

already_counted.description: Draft checks and final publication approval

incremental.description: Maintain templates, recipient rules and publication exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact final content, recipient snapshot, channel and publication time from s3; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R62.5, gross37.5 minus5 upkeep net32.5. Low assumes only12 hours drafting and placement removed because many items need manual edits.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with congregational leaders to encourage programme support

steps.what: Confer with clergy and congregational groups about support and participation

tasks.design: Keep the discussion and encouragement human. Programme information in {DOCS} supports the conversation, but generated talking points do not replace trust or negotiation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Support depends on relationships and local priorities.
tasks.enabler_now: No new tool removes the need for the actual discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Concerns may be sensitive or conflicting.
tasks.human_edge: The director listens and builds voluntary agreement.
tasks.altitude: No change in discussion time or authority.

evidence.claim: Relational support-building remains human work in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is the director's live discussion; others' time and separate publicity are excluded.
Concerns and commitments are elicited in s1's100 hours; no structured support score is assumed.
No system or additional upkeep is introduced, justifying zero incremental work.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 and zero upkeep; no discussion time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather prior fundraising revenue, programme costs and resource constraints
Choose fundraising activities, assess feasibility and agree the plan with church leaders

tasks.design: Use existing {ERP} reports and reusable {SPREADSHEET} tables for the financial preparation. The director and church leaders still choose activities, judge community fit and agree resource commitments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prior revenue and programme cost summaries may be rebuilt repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Integrated church financial administration can supply reusable records.
tasks.still_hard: Donor willingness and volunteer capacity cannot be inferred from totals.
tasks.human_edge: The director chooses appropriate activities with the community.
tasks.altitude: Less table preparation; fundraising strategy stays human.

evidence.claim: DocBase with Exact Online combines parish financial and member administration.
The fundraising preparation saving is an unmeasured scenario, not a reported result.

assumptions: Boundary is planning, excluding campaign publicity, donor contact and accounting entry.

Treasurer produces approved account, period, activity code and amount through unchanged accounting work. Director captures programme needs and reconciles missing classifications within s1's10 remaining hours; unclear coding means manual grouping, not inferred donor profiles.
Test native financial reports first; use aggregate totals rather than sensitive member-level predictions.
research_questions: Can existing reports reduce total planning-table work without weakening reconciliation?

incremental.description: Maintain activity mappings and report definitions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gives10 gross minus3 upkeep net7. Low assumes3 hours table assembly removed; strategy and consultation retain80 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify educational needs and resource selection constraints
Locate periodicals and curricula relevant to the resource brief

loop.purpose: Find relevant resources in an approved collection
loop.input: Resource brief and retrievable catalogue descriptions or passages
loop.output: Candidate resources with source links and reasons for relevance
loop.check: Director opens each source and verifies content, audience, doctrine fit and current availability
loop.stop: One search refinement then manual search if sources are absent or unsuitable
loop.why_not_simpler: Exact filters can narrow the collection but relevance to educational needs requires semantic reading

steps.what: Select suitable resources and confirm permission to distribute them
Distribute selected resources to the intended educational staff

tasks.design: Test native search and shared folders in {DOCS} before adding bounded resource suggestions from {OTHER}, an approved resource catalogue. The director chooses suitable material, checks distribution rights and reviews the exact pack and recipients before sending.
tasks.previous_blocker: Resource discovery and repeated distribution can involve many searches and messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Search over approved descriptions and native folder links can reduce first-pass discovery and copying.
tasks.still_hard: Suitability and distribution rights need judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The director matches resources to actual educational and faith needs.
tasks.altitude: Less first-pass searching and distribution entry; resource selection remains human.

evidence.claim: Bounded source retrieval and reviewed link distribution are plausible; no measured religious-resource result is supplied.

assumptions: Boundary covers locating, selecting and distributing existing resources, excluding curriculum creation and staff use.

Director captures topic, audience, intended use and constraints in s1's15 hours, then confirms exact files or links, rights and recipient selection in s3 and retained s4 time. Existing staff administration supplies contact records through unchanged work; missing rights or contacts require manual clarification.
Test native search and shared folders first. No unlicensed copying or generated references are accepted.
research_questions: Does retrieval reduce search time after suitability and rights checks?

already_counted.description: Search review, selection and distribution checks

incremental.description: Maintain approved sources and distribution templates

approvals.approved_version: Exact selected files or links, permissions and recipient snapshot reviewed in s4; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R72.5 gives27.5 gross minus4 upkeep net23.5. Low assumes only7 hours search and copying removed because resources need manual discovery or physical distribution.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less publicity drafting, financial table preparation and resource searching; support-building remains personal.
reach: Work with the treasurer on clear activity costs
role.ambitious_version: A director who uses reliable information and simpler administration to support meaningful educational programmes.
